historical_method_basis: 2026-06-24 same-model AI-judge-AI 15/15 result was declared unreliable due self-family, length/context, and formatting bias.
R47 design required >=3 independent judges, complete source masking, agreement reporting, and multi-axis craft evaluation.
I4D fresh-human Stage B treated 3 wins +2 ties /9 as a meaningful human-competitive development signal rather than requiring domination.
I4G preserved preregistered win/tie thresholds even when 8 wins/3 losses/1 tie failed its nonloss gate.

ceiling_doctrine.statement: The current OS is already high-performing; this gate targets small, repeatable independent preference/nonloss rather than a large raw-score jump.
ceiling_doctrine.secondary_statistics: within-judge axis deltas; absolute 0-100 readiness is diagnostic only and never a pass gate

judge_pool.selection_rule: Use the first three valid completed judge responses in chronological receipt order. Do not replace a valid unfavorable judge. Replacement slots J04/J05 are allowed only for no-response or protocol-invalid responses before unblind.
independence_requirements: Each judge must run in a separate fresh GPT conversation outside the Literary OS Project and outside this coordinator conversation.
Judge must not receive GitHub/Hub access, coordinator mapping, I4K4 internal scores/results, or another judge response.
Judge must record model/config string and attest no prior exposure to the pair.
No cross-judge discussion before all three valid responses are sealed.
judge_pool.family_boundary: If all valid judges are from the same GPT model family, PASS may be called INDEPENDENT_EXTERNAL_GPT_CONSENSUS only; it is not cross-family or human consensus.

blind_mapping_custody.strategy: A/B assignment is independently randomized per judge packet; consistent within that judge across the full episode and all 12 units.
blind_mapping_custody.coordinator_map: secret file retained coordinator-side; only SHA256 is published before judge release.
blind_mapping_custody.unblind_rule: No mapping file may be opened for analysis until all three valid judge responses are sealed and hashed.
blind_mapping_custody.packet_release_rule: Only anonymized judge-specific packet + common scoring contract may be released.

sample.U01_U10: 10 corresponding full sequence pairs from the sealed I4K4 episodes
sample.U11: whole-episode architecture judgment after reading both complete anonymized episodes
sample.U12: whole-episode broadcast-surface/craft judgment after reading both complete anonymized episodes
sample.independence_note: Units come from one fresh whole episode and are not treated as 12 independent works; claims are episode-level external replication, not population generalization.

global_axis_scores.scale: 1-10 in 0.5 increments, A and B separately after direct preference

judge_output_contract.no_chain_of_thought: Judges provide concise reasons only, not hidden reasoning.

critical_verification: A subjective critical violation is VERIFIED only when >=2 of 3 valid judges independently flag the same substantive locus/category. Objective source/meta leakage may be mechanically verified. Any VERIFIED critical violation fails H4.

H3_WHOLE_EPISODE_AND_CEILING_SENSITIVE_A.U11_U12_rule: At least one of U11/U12 is a Treatment majority win and the other is Treatment nonloss.

H4_RELIABILITY_AND_SAFETY.agreement_metric: Fleiss kappa reported diagnostically; not a hard gate because of prevalence/tie effects.

decision_rule.FAIL: Valid 3-judge execution with any H1-H4 effect/safety gate failed => FAIL, preserve result; no threshold change.
decision_rule.HOLD: Fewer than 3 valid judges, mapping custody breach, packet mismatch, or scoring-contract integrity failure => HOLD, no scientific verdict.

claim_boundary: PASS is independent external GPT consensus on the sealed I4K4 episode, not independent human consensus.
PASS does not prove population-wide generalization, human-writer superiority, Production promotion, Formal R140, or genuine OpenAI Live qualification.
Because current ceiling is high, absence of large raw-score separation does not itself fail the gate; frozen pairwise/nonloss criteria govern.
